name: roi_xz6_h013_pilot_b500
description: ROI six-covariate paired VCTR pilot with h=0.13 and paired-visit row bootstrap.
notes: The six Z columns are sex plus paired-eye mean VF values at locations 1, 22, 25, 28, and 31.
Paired-visit rows are sampled with replacement; OD and OS remain paired within each sampled row.
Repeated visits from the same patient are treated as independent by this bootstrap sensitivity design.
The full grid is computed, but plots mark grid points with fewer than 30 local pairs as low support.
CP features and all preprocessing transformations remain fixed.
